info.name: NParksPetHealth API
info.description: Postman collection for NParksPetHealth API v1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server host (e.g. https://localhost:7001).

query.description: Identity provider: 'singpass' or 'corppass'
Redirect URI registered with the IDP

request.description: Returns the IDP authorization URL. The client redirects the user to this URL to initiate the login flow.
Exchanges an authorization code returned by the IDP for access and refresh tokens.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.
Revokes a refresh token (logout from the current device).

[DEVELOPMENT ONLY] Issues a signed JWT directly from the supplied claims, bypassing the OIDC flow. userType: pet_owner | veterinarian | nparks_admin | aqc_staff. aqcStaffRole (for aqc_staff): officer | supervisor | vet | contractor. Returns 404 in non-Development environments.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin management endpoints. Requires NParksAdmin authorization.

request.description: Creates a new NParks admin account. Account status defaults to inactive.

response.name: 409 Conflict

query.description: Filter by account status: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'. Omit for all.

request.description: Lists all NParks admin accounts (non-deleted). Optionally filter by status.
Returns a single NParks admin by ID.
Updates the account status of a NParks admin. Accepted values: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'.
Soft-deletes a NParks admin account.

query.description: Filter by account status: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'. Omit for all.

request.description: Lists all veterinarians (non-deleted). Optionally filter by account status.
Updates the account status of a veterinarian. Accepted values: 'active', 'inactive', 'suspended'.

item.name: Master Data
item.description: Master data management endpoints. Read operations require any authenticated user. Write/update operations require NParksAdmin.

request.description: Creates a new pet species. Requires NParksAdmin role.

response.name: 409 Conflict

query.description: Filter by active status. Omit to return all.

request.description: Lists pet species. Optionally filter by isActive.
Updates the active status of a pet species. Requires NParksAdmin role.
Creates a new pet breed. Requires NParksAdmin role.

response.name: 409 Conflict

query.description: Filter by species ID.
Filter by HDB approval status.
Filter by active status. Omit to return all.

request.description: Lists pet breeds. Optionally filter by speciesId, isHdbApproved, isActive.
Updates the active status of a pet breed. Requires NParksAdmin role.
Creates a new vaccine type. Requires NParksAdmin role. applicableSpeciesId null means universal (all species).

request.description: Lists vet specialisations. Optionally filter by isActive.

item.name: Animal Stay (AQC)
item.description: Animal quarantine centre stay management. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Creates a new animal stay (registers an animal arrival). species: 'Dog' | 'Cat' | 'Other'. sex: 'Male' | 'Female' | 'Unknown' (defaults to Unknown if null). countryCode: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

response.name: 409 Conflict

request.description: Gets a single animal stay by ID.

query.description: Filter by status: 'staying', 'released', 'deceased'. Omit for all.
Filter by species: 'Dog', 'Cat', 'Other'. Omit for all.
Search by animal name or microchip number.

request.description: Lists animal stays. Optionally filter by status, species, or search term (name/microchip).
Updates the status of an animal stay. status: 'released' | 'deceased'. releaseDate is required when status is 'released'.

response.name: 409 Conflict

query.description: Filter by active status. Omit to return all.

request.description: Lists all kennels. Optionally filter by isActive.

query.description: Filter by active status. Omit to return all.

request.description: Lists all countries. Optionally filter by isActive.

item.name: Arrival Exam (AQC)
item.description: Arrival physical examination and draft management. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Submits the baseline physical examination for an animal stay. mentation: 'Responsive' | 'Calm' | 'Active' | 'Alert'. system: 'skin' | 'eyes' | 'nose' | 'ears' | 'mouth' | 'hydration' | 'respiratory'. Each system may appear at most once. vetStaffId must reference an aqc_staff member with role='vet'.

response.name: 409 Conflict

request.description: Gets the arrival exam for an animal stay.
Saves (or replaces) the exam portion of the current officer's arrival draft. All fields are optional. Creates the draft row if it does not yet exist.
Returns the current officer's full arrival draft including both the animal details and exam portions.

response.name: 404 Not Found

request.description: Deletes the current officer's arrival draft (clears both the animal details and exam portions).

item.name: Daily Inspection (AQC)
item.description: Daily AM/PM inspection endpoints. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Submits a daily AM or PM inspection for an animal stay. Only one inspection per session per day is permitted. The stay must be in active-monitoring status. session: AM | PM. mentation: Responsive | Calm | Active | Alert. food: Full | Half | Little | None. stool: Firm | Soft | Loose | Watery | None. urine: Yes | No. systemFindings[].system: skin | eyes | nose | ears | mouth | hydration | cardiorespiratory. systemFindings[].finding: normal | abnormal.

response.name: 409 Conflict — already recorded

query.description: Filter by inspection date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

request.description: Lists all daily inspections for an animal stay. Optionally filter by date (format: YYYY-MM-DD).
Gets a single daily inspection by its ID.

item.name: Observation (AQC)
item.description: Health observation endpoints. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Submits a free-text health observation, optionally linked to an animal stay. Media keys (photos/videos) must be pre-uploaded via POST /api/v1/media/presign. The observation is created with status=processing and routed to AI analysis. mediaKind: 'photo' | 'video'.

item.name: Medication (AQC)

query.description: Date for which to list animals with active medication schedules (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

request.description: Returns animals that have at least one active medication schedule on the given date. Animals with overdue doses appear first. Contractor scope is applied server-side.

query.description: Date for which to retrieve dose slots (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

item.name: Media (AQC)
item.description: Media presign endpoints for uploading photos and videos. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Generates presigned PUT URLs for direct media upload to object storage. Upload each file to the returned uploadUrl using HTTP PUT, then supply the returned mediaKey when submitting an observation or arrival exam. mediaKind: 'photo' | 'video'. context: 'observation' | 'exam'. contentType examples: 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/heic', 'video/mp4', 'video/quicktime'. Maximum 5 items per request. URLs expire in 5 minutes.

item.name: Notifications (AQC)
item.description: Device push token management endpoints. Requires AqcStaff authorization.

request.description: Registers or refreshes the calling staff member's FCM/APNs device push token. One active token is stored per (staffId, platform); subsequent calls for the same platform replace the previous token. platform: 'android' | 'ios'. Token max length: 512 chars.

query.description: Platform whose token should be revoked: 'android' | 'ios'.

request.description: Revokes the push token for the specified platform. Should be called on explicit logout so the device stops receiving notifications. Idempotent — returns 204 even if no token was registered.
